reason: A dsh web visual skin that replaces the homepage background with themed fluid effects, grid elements, and a digital whale while preserving the existing layout and input area.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh web 首页添加带有流体光效、点线网格和数字点云鲸鱼的深浅主题背景皮肤。
summaries.en: Adds a light and dark visual skin to the dsh web homepage with fluid effects, a dot-line grid, and a digital point-cloud whale.

capabilities: changes the dsh web homepage background and visual styling
provides light and dark theme variants

adds a settings toggle for enabling or disabling the skin
